press_references.value: Deliverect and SoundHound AI partner to automate restaurant voice orders

partnership_announcements.description: Deliverect and SoundHound AI announced a partnership connecting SoundHound’s Smart Ordering voice agents with Deliverect’s order and menu management platform. about_short_description.short_description: Deliverect integrates online orders from food delivery channels into restaurants’ POS to improve their operational flow.

product.name: Deliverect Platform
product.description: An AI-powered, API-first platform that centralizes digital ordering, menu management, delivery operations, and sales data across restaurant and retail channels.

product.name: Deliverect Restaurants
product.description: A centralized restaurant operations hub for aggregating orders, managing menus, and accessing sales, performance, and third-party delivery data from one platform.

product.name: Deliverect Direct
product.description: A direct-to-consumer ordering solution for creating branded websites, mobile apps, and QR-code ordering experiences with integrated promotions, payments, and loyalty.

product.name: Dispatch by Deliverect
product.description: A delivery orchestration service that assigns orders across third-party and in-house fleets using delivery partner integrations, business rules, cost, coverage, and estimated arrival time.

product.name: Sentinel by Deliverect
product.description: A revenue protection and marketplace monitoring solution that tracks storefront availability, performance, pricing, promotions, customer sentiment, and refund activity across delivery platforms.

product.name: Deliverect Commerce API
product.description: A modular API suite for building custom first-party ordering experiences and connecting branded applications to POS, loyalty, kitchen, payment, and delivery systems.
